scope: static, AI-assisted, diff only, read-only, nothing executed; tile shapes checked at head (64 KiB tiles, power-of-two sizes)
findings: resource_detile.h: the memcpy per element is replaced by a reinterpret_cast to an Element struct of Bpe bytes over std::byte storage. No Element object lives there, so the access is undefined behaviour (strict aliasing) that a compiler may miscompile. A memcpy of the constant size Bpe compiles to the same moves; keeping memcpy or using std::bit_cast avoids it. Not malicious.
